# Nanticoke Heating & Cooling

> Nanticoke Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Nanticoke, Brant/Haldimand-Norfolk, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 587-3164  |  Email: contact@nanticokeheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://nanticokeheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Nanticoke, Brantford, Paris, Caledonia, Dunnville, Simcoe, Port Dover, Ayr, Aylmer
